name: test_authored_test_validate
description: Pre-check an agent-authored test file (exactly one new, test-shaped file that references the changed code) before spending a red/green run on it. Gated behind allowAgentAuthoredTests.

repoPath.description: Absolute path to the git repository whose current uncommitted working tree the author_missing_test agent step just left dirty.

candidateCommit.description: The real candidate commit the agent was trying to cover, before the new test file. Used to confirm the authored path did not already exist at this commit.

changedPaths.description: The real candidate's own changed paths, used for the content check: the authored file's text must reference at least one non-test path from this list by name or basename.

accepted.description: True only when the agent touched exactly one new, test-shaped file that references the changed code and did not already exist at the baseline.

reason.description: Why the attempt was rejected; empty when accepted.

authoredPath.description: The single new file's repository-relative path; empty when rejected before a path could be identified.

touchedPaths.description: Every path the agent's working tree shows as changed, for diagnostics -- ideally exactly one.

matchedIdentifier.description: The non-test changed path whose name/basename the authored file's text referenced; empty when rejected or no match found.
